notes: Fiscal year ended 31 December 2025 (BYD 2025 Annual Report on HKEXnews). Statements prepared under PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CASBE), direct-method cash flow. Interest paid cannot be separated from dividends (null, not added), so paidOut omits cash interest to lenders. Operating cash inflows also include other income proceeds (mainly government subsidies) of 9,594,083 and tax rebates of 17,048,237 (both lower paidOut; not adjusted). Operating cash flow fell to 59,135,544 from 133,453,873 while capex rose to 156,807,853, so paidOut rose much faster than revenue. financeReceivablesInOCF left null: the statement does not show whether auto-finance receivables move through 'operating receivables'. Capex is the single combined CASBE line.
